_encoding: u64/u128 fields are JSON strings; numbers above 2^53 lose precision through JSON.parse. init-markets.ts converts via BN(string).
_pnl_deficit_relief: resolve_perp_pnl_deficit is intentionally disabled at launch: unrealized_pnl_max_imbalance stays 0 on-chain and max_revenue_withdraw_per_period is a $100 placeholder. Size both together if the path is ever enabled.
_tier: public_launch_v2_2_6M (risk-research velocity_init_params.json _ramp): vAMM total $1.71M split 2:2:2:1 BTC/ETH/SOL/HYPE, quote IF vault $180k. OI caps are the zero-socialization caps from the cascade re-run at these reserves: majors $1.35M, HYPE $340k. Raising OI above these socializes residual losses in a >40% crash; raise vAMM capital instead.

_decisions_2026_08_28.amm_base/quote_asset_reserve, max_open_i: CHANGED to the 2.6M tier values. Reserves are computed at the 2026-05-26 reference peg; re-derive at the live oracle price when proposing update_k (reserves scale with peg).
_decisions_2026_08_28.curve_update_intensity: CHANGED 104/101/101/100 -> 120 all markets (bridge quoting update: 20bp shift cap; principle cap >= taker fee; revisit if fee lands > 20bp).
_decisions_2026_08_28.amm_jit_intensity: CHANGED to 0 on all markets: AMM does not participate against JIT. Risk recommended 0/0/0/10 (HYPE minimal shedding-only, band 10-25, pending confirm); team decision 2026-08-28 is full off, revisit HYPE after week-1 review.
_decisions_2026_08_28.max_spread (HYPE): CHANGED 2500 -> 20000 (25bp -> 200bp). Measured market-59 flow: 25bp fails at every response rate; 200bp holds at e 0.10 native / 0.20 stressed. Majors stay 20000/10000/10000.
_decisions_2026_08_28.funding_clamp_threshold / funding_ramp_s: SET EXPLICIT to the live program defaults (5 bps dead zone, 1.0x slope). No risk-derived per-market fits exist yet; field docs say fit per market post-launch. Open item with risk.
_decisions_2026_08_28.funding_bias_sensitivity: STAYS 0 (off). Risk derived k=0.5 (sensitivity 50) from the bias counterfactual but launch ships 0, channel untested. Not a field of this file; set via its update ix when enabled.
_decisions_2026_08_28.amm_peg_multiplier: STAYS as reference-price documentation only; always re-peg from the live oracle when touching reserves.
_decisions_2026_08_28.max_open_interest step alignment: OI values floored to order_step_size multiples; the program rejects max_open_interest not divisible by the step. Raw cascade outputs are not aligned.
_decisions_2026_08_28.quote_max_insurance (HYPE): STAYS 20000000000 (live launch value). Risk tier says 10000000000; team accepted the live value for now. Trimming to 10k is an open item.
_decisions_2026_08_28.taker_fee_addon_tenth_bps: ADDED as documentation: +1.5bp on HYPE (15 tenth-bps), 0 elsewhere. Set via fees set-taker-addon, not by the init script.
